'''Kesin Ommis''' was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. During the [[Battle of Hoth]], Ommis served as the tailgunner for [[Rebel pilot]] [[Derek Klivian|Derek "Hobbie" Klivian]] in their [[T-47 airspeeder]].<ref name="Complete Locations" /> He<ref name="FACPOV ESB" /> and Hobbie both perished in Hoth when they rammed their snowspeeder into the cockpit of [[All Terrain Armored Transport]] ''[[Blizzard 1]]''.<ref name="OTFL">''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]''</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The back of the helmet and shoulders of Hobbie's gunner can be glimpsed behind the pilot in a promotional photograph from [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']],<ref name="CardTrader">{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=Hobbie Klivian - Snowspeeder Gunner}}</ref> and in a partial deleted scene from the film as seen in the ''[[Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]'' Blu-ray release of the films.<ref name="Blu-ray">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]''</ref>
